response.overview: Set in Brooklyn, a teenage Miles Morales struggles to balance high school life and his family expectations with sudden superpowers after a bite from a genetically engineered spider. Gifted with unique bio-electric "venom blasts" and camouflage abilities, Miles must learn what it truly means to be a hero under the mentorship of an experienced And Unexperienced Peter Parker. However, his dual life is pushed to the limit when a local criminal threat emerges that strikes dangerously close to home, forcing Miles to step out of the shadows and claim his own identity as Spider-Man.
response.title: Spider-Man: Miles Morales
